Training

Overview

Training with Mowatek

Systems perform best when the people operating them understand how they work. Mowatek provides technical training and support for teams responsible for water and wastewater treatment equipment.

Training content and format are agreed through an enquiry so that they fit your equipment, your site and your team.

Formats

  • On-site training at your facility
  • Workshops for groups
  • Support alongside equipment handover
  • Custom content: discuss your requirements
Topics

What this includes

Scope is confirmed with you for each project.

Water treatment operations

Operating, monitoring and troubleshooting water treatment equipment.

Wastewater management

Understanding wastewater processes and day-to-day operation.

Equipment maintenance

Routine checks and maintenance practice for treatment equipment.

Laboratory & analysis

Sampling and testing fundamentals that support operations.

Safety & compliance

Safe working practice around treatment equipment and sites.

Supervision & management

Supporting the people who lead operating teams.

How we work

Dependable solutions start with understanding the problem.

  1. 01

    Understand

    We start with your site, your constraints and what you need the system to achieve.

  4. 04

    Clear communication through delivery, and technical backup as systems go into use.
